scope: Isolated in-memory cadence scaling of one corrected single-stride reference. Only ref.fps changes; positions, policy models, command speed and the on-disk active bank do not change. This is not a new neural-planner speed generation.

loop.phaseAnchor: Consecutive left-knee swing peaks; one complete same-leg stride

lowSpeedEffectiveness.note: These extra movement checks identify deadzone behavior independently of unchanged posture/fall/stop thresholds. A posture-pass can still be a locomotion failure.

interpretation: Only sampled cadence factors were tested on the same .4m/s source geometry. Actual physical movement and posture status are separate. These are cadence-scaled targets, not newly generated neural reference speeds, and monotonic behavior between samples is not established.

resultSummary.interpretation: Only factors .65 and .75 were observed in the requested .1.. .3m/s physical-speed band. Factor .5 gives about .09m/s and is not validated as an exact .1m/s command. Factors .25/.4 remain below the band. This is a cadence compensation experiment, not generation of new neural-planner references.

archiveSummary.omission: Only array-valued samples properties were removed recursively. Their lengths are retained as sampleCount. Numeric samples counts and all other metrics, thresholds, provenance, failures, source hashes and sourceChanges are preserved.
archiveSummary.summaryChecksum: Stored in homepage/qa/archive-index.json; omitted here to avoid a self-referential hash.
